applies_why: The judge text states a RESULT of DEFENDER WINS and relies on a challenge standing and collision grade, so the RESULT rule governs it.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count: one reading disallows using the retracted BROKEN grade as support for DEFENDER WINS; the other would let the earlier BROKEN text count despite retraction.
why: The judge awards DEFENDER WINS while its stated basis for non-self-support is a CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade that the same text retracts, and a standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
